⚡ A simple utility script for daily use
Hey everyone, I’m sharing a small script I’ve been working on for personal use. It’s a basic utility tool, so please keep in mind that it might be a bit "hit or miss" sometimes. It’s not perfect and you might run into some bugs or laggy moments, but it gets the job done for the most part.

Spam: Basic DoubleTap & Running automation.
Auto Push: Automatic pushing mechanism (might feel a bit sluggish depending on the server).
Anti-Ragdoll: Helps prevent ragdoll states.
Teleport: Quick warp to key locations (keep in mind it might be a bit unstable depending on your ping or game state).
ESP: For basic player tracking.
Server Hop: A simple tool to hop into a smaller server (4-9 players).
Feel free to try it out if you’d like. It’s a work in progress, so if you encounter any bugs or have suggestions on how I can improve it, let me know! Feedback is always welcome. Thanks! 🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥
